description: Create a Stripe-hosted checkout for one Agent Field Kit product and return its URL. Does NOT charge anything: a human, or an agent with explicit payment authority, must pay on the returned page. Prices: single template $29 (Agent Security Audit Kit $79), full kit of the 4 original templates $79, team license (10 users) $199. 14-day no-questions refunds. Also sold: Cyber Defense Bundle $79, Bundle + 1 year Cyber Desk Pro $199. Returns session_id and status_url; after payment call get_order with the session_id to receive signed download links (agent-to-agent purchase flow). Returns 'checkout_not_open' until checkout launches.
